summary: Batch #38 — Emergency/Medical revamp (blood-group dropdown, allergy chips + Other, doctor_phone, 4 insurance types) + Login redesign (helper button on Welcome, simplified email login, PIN picker with always-visible bottom actions) + Forgot-password Spam/Junk hint. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_batch38_medical_helper_isolation.py, JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_batch38_results.xml): 5/5 PASS in ~2s. Verified: (1) PUT /api/emergency/medical/{parent.member_id} persists doctor_phone AND insurance[{type,provider,policy_number,phone}] — response includes both fields with round-tripped values (health/vehicle rows verified individually). (2) GET as SAME parent returns blood_group + allergies + doctor + doctor_phone + insurance array (2 entries) + can_view_detail:true. (3) SECURITY (code-level detail gating): _MEDICAL_DETAIL_FIELDS at server.py:4791-4792 correctly lists {medication, conditions, doctor, doctor_phone, hospital, insurance_provider, policy_reference, insurance, emergency_contact}; get_medical_card at 5109-5113 iterates the tuple and pops each key when viewer lacks detail permission, then sets detail_restricted=True — so a limited/child viewer receives ONLY blood_group + allergies + member + can_view_detail:false. Demo family has no child-role account with a linked user_id, so this is confirmed via static analysis (list membership + pop loop) rather than a runtime call — matches the batch note that says 'confirm the gating logic via code + the _MEDICAL_DETAIL_FIELDS list'. (4) SECURITY helper isolation: GET /api/helper/medical returns ONLY {member, blood_group, allergies, doctor, hospital, emergency_contact} per card — the response JSON does NOT contain 'doctor_phone', 'insurance', 'medication', 'conditions', 'insurance_provider', or 'policy_reference' as keys. Confirmed by seeding Aarav (Sunita's assigned child) with doctor_phone='+91 98700 12345' and insurance policy_number='HELPER-LEAK-TEST', then asserting the raw helper /medical response body does NOT contain either leak marker (server.py:7371-7376 constructs the dict field-by-field, so no scope creep is possible). FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): (A) LOGIN REDESIGN — Welcome shows the bordered 'I'm a trusted helper' button (helper-portal-link) with briefcase icon at the bottom of the actions stack, plus 'I already have an account' (login-link-btn). Tapping login-link-btn opens login.tsx: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, then an 'or continue with' divider, then Google (login-google-btn) + Apple, then the light 'Family member? Sign in with a PIN' link (login-pin-btn). Tapping login-pin-btn opens the PIN 'Who's this?' picker — with no saved PINs on this fresh web browser the picker shows the padlock 'No quick sign-ins saved on this device yet' hint and BOTH bottom actions are always visible: 'Sign in with email & password' (pin-email-login, secondary bordered) and 'I'm a trusted helper' (pin-helper-login, brandTertiary background). pin-back returns to Welcome (helper-portal-link visible again). End-to-end email login with storytester@fam.com / secret123 succeeded (URL '/' after submit). (B) FORGOT-PASSWORD — /(auth)/forgot: entered storytester@fam.com, tapped 'Send reset code' (forgot-send-btn) — the API call returned success and the page transitioned to the 'Enter your code' step with a visible pink hint card: 'Can't find it? Check your Spam / Junk folder — the code can take a minute to arrive.' plus the 6-digit code + new password inputs and 'Reset password' button + 'Didn't get it? Resend code' link. (Did NOT assert email delivery per instructions.) (C) MEDICAL EDITOR — /emergency/medical/mem_29ad14388e9549b5 (Raj). VIEW mode: blood-group card shows 'O+' with red border, allergies card shows 3 pills 'Peanuts / Dust / Kiwi', Doctor row shows 'Dr. Mehta' + '+91 98765 43210' with a green call button (call-doctor testID visible), Insurance section shows 'Health insurance / Star Health / Policy: SH-DEMO-001' and 'Vehicle insurance / ICICI Lombard / Policy: VH-DEMO-002' rows with call icons, plus Emergency contact row. Tapping edit-medcard-btn: all 8 blood-group chips render (bg-A+ … bg-O-), popular allergy pills present (allergy-Peanuts, allergy-Dust and all 14 in COMMON_ALLERGIES verified via testID probing), Doctor's name (medcard-doctor) + Doctor's phone (medcard-doctor_phone, phone-pad) fields present, 4 insurance cards render with all 12 testIDs {ins-health-provider, ins-health-policy, ins-health-phone, ins-critical-*, ins-term-*, ins-vehicle-*}, allergy-custom-input + allergy-add button add a removable custom tag ('TestX_B38' appeared as an on-brand pill with X). Tapping bg-O+ once clears (chip toggles to unselected), tapping again re-selects it. Tapping save-medcard-btn (Save Card) posts PUT, returns to VIEW mode (edit-medcard-btn reappears), and the persisted 'TestX_B38' tag shows alongside Peanuts/Dust/Kiwi confirming save round-trip. NO React Native red screen, no crashes; only benign expo-notifications web warnings + expected 401s from probing fetch injection while unauthenticated. Regression on touched screens: Welcome / login / forgot / medical view+edit all functional. Data left tidy — Aarav's medical card restored to demo defaults (O+ / Peanuts / Dr. Mehta / Apollo Hospital / Priya +91 98111 00099 / insurance:[]); Raj's medical card cleaned of the TestX_B38 tag and restored to O+ / Peanuts, Dust, Kiwi / Dr. Mehta / +91 98765 43210 / Health(Star Health, SH-DEMO-001) + Vehicle(ICICI Lombard, VH-DEMO-002) / Priya +91 98111 00099. No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected in the Batch #38 files (medical/[id].tsx, welcome.tsx, login.tsx, pin.tsx, forgot.tsx).
action_items: None blocking. Optional: add a runtime pytest for a non-detail viewer (e.g., seed a child-role member with a linked_user_id and login) to exercise the pop-loop end-to-end via HTTP instead of static-analysis. Guard is at server.py:5109-5113 and _MEDICAL_DETAIL_FIELDS at 4791-4792.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:721-740 MedicalCardIn now accepts insurance: List[InsuranceEntryIn] and doctor_phone; InsuranceEntryIn requires 'type' (str) and permits null provider/policy_number/phone — Pydantic v2 model validates upserts cleanly.

server.py:4791-4792 _MEDICAL_DETAIL_FIELDS correctly adds both 'doctor_phone' AND 'insurance' to the gated tuple, so a viewer without medical-detail permission (child or non-family member) receives ONLY blood_group + allergies + can_view_detail=false + detail_restricted=true.
server.py:5109-5113 get_medical_card iterates the tuple with out.pop(f, None) — safe idempotent removal; the resulting response is stripped of doctor/doctor_phone/insurance/etc. for limited viewers.

server.py:7355-7377 /helper/medical hand-constructs the per-card dict with only {member, blood_group, allergies, doctor, hospital, emergency_contact} — new doctor_phone and insurance fields are NOT copied over, so no scope creep is possible even if the underlying medical_cards document contains them (verified by seeding Aarav with a leak marker and asserting absence).

frontend/app/(auth)/welcome.tsx:65-70 helper-portal-link is a full-width Pressable with 1.5px white-border, briefcase icon, and 44px+ touch target (paddingVertical: spacing.md) — meets mobile touch-target guideline.

frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx:101-123 divider row + Google/Apple + login-pin-btn all wired; login-pin-btn uses router.replace('/(auth)/pin') so the back button from the PIN picker cleanly returns to Welcome without duplicating history entries.

frontend/app/(auth)/pin.tsx:120-124 pin-email-login (bordered secondary) + pin-helper-login (brandTertiary background) render as always-visible bottom actions — good discoverability regardless of saved-PIN state.
frontend/app/(auth)/forgot.tsx:86-90 Spam/Junk hint card renders on the 'code' step ONLY (not the email-entry step) — matches spec 'verify step shows the hint'.

frontend/app/emergency/medical/[id].tsx:107-124 save() flattens allergies to a comma-joined string, keeps only insurance entries with any of provider/policy_number/phone (filter drops all-empty rows), and null-coerces empty strings — clean PUT payload. Blood-group toggle logic at line 189 correctly clears when chip is tapped again.

frontend/app/emergency/medical/[id].tsx:293-332 VIEW mode gates the Doctor row on (card.doctor || card.doctor_phone) and shows the call-doctor button only when doctor_phone exists — matches spec. Insurance rows filter out empty entries and render an icon+label+provider+policy+optional call icon per row.

rca_of_issue: N/A — all 3 Batch #38 change groups verified. (1) Medical revamp: new doctor_phone + insurance persist end-to-end; view+edit UIs render every spec'd testID; save round-trips. (2) Login redesign: helper-portal-link is a clearly visible bordered button on Welcome; simplified login has the 'or continue with' divider + Google/Apple + PIN link; PIN picker always shows pin-email-login + pin-helper-login; pin-back returns to Welcome — no navigation dead-ends. (3) Forgot password: Spam/Junk hint shows on the verify step after a successful /forgot request. (4) Security: doctor_phone + insurance are correctly added to _MEDICAL_DETAIL_FIELDS (viewer gating), and /helper/medical hand-picks its response so those fields cannot leak to helpers even when the underlying document contains them.
